name: chip-capacitor
title: Chip capacitor body
summary: Multilayer ceramic chip capacitor: barium-titanate body between two matte-tin wrapped terminations (length, width, height, termination, body_round, end_round).
provenance: Original work: the in-code chip builder's construction (crates/solidcraft-integration/src/models/chip.rs) of a 0603 chip, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored`; the chip generator gives every parameter its value. Estimated edge rounds and overcoat, no vendor drawing or EDA/CAD library data copied.
